description: Kevin's drunken farewell confession to Audrey becomes an office-wide problem when his overseas job disappears and he has to return to the cubicle beside her. Their attempts to act normal are complicated by Audrey's boyfriend Brock, Kevin dating other women, Roxie's chaotic move into his apartment, and coworkers who keep turning private embarrassment into public gossip. By the finale, Audrey's jealousy and trouble with Brock give Kevin a reason to stop playing harmless friend and finally compete for her.

s01e01.description: Kevin gives Audrey a candid farewell letter and tells her he loves her because he expects to leave for an overseas job. When the transfer collapses and he is back at the office almost immediately, both have to work beside each other with the confession now impossible to ignore.

s01e02.description: Kevin and Audrey try to restore a professional routine after his confession, but the private letter becomes office gossip when its contents reach the company newsletter. Roxie meanwhile forms an unlikely friendship with Patti, giving Kevin one more personal connection inside an already intrusive workplace.

s01e03.description: Audrey sets Kevin up with one of her friends and then discovers that watching the date bothers her more than she expected. Brian becomes Patti's personal trainer, while Roxie responds to unemployment by deciding that acting might be a viable career.

s01e04.description: A strong performance review makes Kevin determined to help struggling coworker Ricky improve his standing with Julia. Audrey recruits Patti to solve a problem for their boss, while Brian, feeling ignored, starts spending more time with Roxie.

s01e05.description: Kevin's attempt to impose an elaborate set of house rules drives Roxie out of his apartment and into Patti and Audrey's place. His relief at getting his space back is undercut when he becomes convinced that Roxie and Roger are developing a romantic connection.

s01e06.description: Julia leaves Kevin and Audrey in charge of the office for the day, giving Audrey a chance to prove she can manage the staff while Kevin tries to keep his birthday secret. Their coworkers discover the date anyway and turn his wish for a quiet day into another workplace production.

s01e07.description: Kevin discovers Julia's private executive bathroom and shares the hidden perk with Audrey, forcing them to keep their unauthorized access from the rest of the office. Away from that secret, Roxie's blunt relationship advice to Patti creates consequences Roxie has to deal with herself.

s01e08.description: Kevin is assigned to run the office earthquake drill on the same day he has an important job interview, putting his current responsibilities directly against a possible escape route. He also avoids Audrey after their latest confrontation, while Roxie challenges Audrey over the way she has been treating him.

s01e09.description: Confined at home, Kevin processes his feelings for Audrey and his office frustrations through a stylized black-and-white dream. Roxie focuses on an attractive male nurse, while Patti inserts herself into Audrey's outings with Brock and sees more of their relationship problems firsthand.

s01e10.description: Kevin decides that remaining the endlessly accommodating friend is getting him nowhere and starts openly exploiting the growing problems between Audrey and Brock. Audrey's reactions force the triangle into the open as Kevin finally competes for the relationship he has wanted all season.
